mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sign_streak_coupon_grant (idempotency_key, user_id, coupon_id, streak_days, status, create_time) VALUES (#{bean.idempotencyKey}, #{bean.userId}, #{bean.couponId}, #{bean.streakDays}, 0, #{bean.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, idempotency_key, user_id, coupon_id, streak_days, user_coupon_id, status, reject_reason, create_time, update_time FROM sign_streak_coupon_grant WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE sign_streak_coupon_grant SET status = 1, user_coupon_id = #{userCouponId}, reject_reason = NULL, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND status = 0
